# Dainty Dazzle | Complete Site Reference

> True beauty shines from within, and our jewelry merely reflects it.

Dainty Dazzle (brand name: Lumiere) is an editorial, cinematic, high-fashion jewelry storefront. We offer delicate, handcrafted pieces in 14k gold, rose gold, sterling silver, and silk cord, designed for layering, stacking, and everyday elegance.

---

## Collections

### Necklaces
Chains, pendants, and chokers designed to sit beautifully on bare skin. From everyday delicates to statement pieces.

### Earrings
Studs, huggies, and drops - small enough to wear every day, detailed enough to notice.

---

## Products

### Whisper Chain Necklace
An impossibly delicate cable chain in 14k gold, designed to sit just below the collarbone. The kind of necklace you forget you're wearing, until someone notices.
- Price: from $128.00 USD
- Variants: 16 inch, 18 inch
- Category: Necklaces

### Luna Stud Earrings
Tiny crescent moon studs in brushed sterling silver. Subtle enough for every day, interesting enough to get compliments.
- Price: $64.00 USD
- Category: Earrings

### Eternity Thin Ring
A thread-thin band in 14k rose gold, set with micro pavé diamonds that catch light from every angle. Stackable, of course.
- Price: $245.00 USD
- Variants: Size 5, Size 6, Size 7
- Category: Rings

### Silk Bar Bracelet
A curved gold bar on a silk cord. Adjustable, weightless, and the perfect quiet luxury accent for any wrist.
- Price: $86.00 USD
- Category: Bracelets

### Dewdrop Pendant
A single pear-cut cubic zirconia suspended on an invisible nylon thread. Appears to float just below the throat.
- Price: $92.00 USD (was $115.00)
- Category: Necklaces

### Halo Huggie Earrings
Small gold huggies that click snugly against the lobe. Pavé-set with tiny stones that sparkle when you turn your head.
- Price: $156.00 USD
- Category: Earrings

### Signet Pinky Ring
A miniature oval signet in polished gold, sized for the pinky. Engravable on request (your initial, a date, or a tiny symbol).
- Price: $178.00 USD
- Variants: Size 4, Size 5
- Category: Rings

### Woven Chain Bracelet
Interlocking flat links in 14k gold that drape like fabric around the wrist. Lobster clasp with 1-inch extender.
- Price: $210.00 USD
- Category: Bracelets

## Policies

### Shipping Policy
- Domestic: Ships within 1–3 business days. Free standard shipping on orders over $150. Flat $5.95 under $150.
- Expedited: Priority Mail (2–3 days) $12.95, Express Mail (1–2 days) $24.95.
- International: USPS International, rates at checkout. 7–21 business days. Import duties are buyer's responsibility.
- Tracking: Tracking number emailed on shipment; allow 24 hours for updates.

### Return & Refund Policy
- Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery for unworn items in original packaging.
- Refunds processed within 5 business days to original payment method. Shipping is non-refundable.
- Exchanges: Free return shipping on exchanges.
- Final Sale: Custom-engraved and "Final Sale" items cannot be returned.

### Terms & Conditions
- Prices in USD, subject to change. Slight variations in handcrafted pieces are natural.
- All site content is the intellectual property of Dainty Dazzle.
- Dainty Dazzle is not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

### Privacy Policy
- We collect name, email, shipping address, and payment info for orders.
- We use essential cookies and Google Analytics. We never sell personal data.
- Order data retained 7 years for tax/legal compliance.
- Deletion requests: hello@daintydazzle.com.

---
